body:
Founder asked to check on a backgrounded duel_wotan_phase3c_e2e.sh run that had stalled. Root cause: the scratch CDP harness hardcoded its Chrome remote-debugging port (19223) with no timeout on any CDP round-trip, so a prior run's not-fully-reaped Chrome process could collide with a rerun and hang it forever with no self-recovery (task bcud2ohkw, PIDs already killed earlier the same day). Verified directly (ps/ss) that nothing was actually still stuck at the time of this pass -- no process bound to that port, no chrome/node/python processes, no zombies. Randomized the harness's debug port to prevent recurrence, then re-ran fresh: real headless Chrome loaded the currently-deployed friends.html (MD5-confirmed identical to /var/www/wotan/friends.html), logged in, rendered the accepted duel's match_token + Copy token button, and a real trusted click resolved navigator.clipboard.writeText() -- button showed 'Copied!', screenshotted. Reconfirms Duel Phase 3c (WOTAN 61bfbce, Apple #20690, BACKLOG SECTION 537) is genuinely shipped and working against what's live today. WOTAN CHANGELOG updated; no app code or README change needed (claims already accurate).

⚓ ☃
title: Diagnosed stalled Duel Phase 3c e2e run, cleared it, re-verified friends.html match_token + Copy button fresh
